obligation: G056 -- one stream whose prefixes are increasingly faithful models
layout: PLANE-MAJOR: all of plane 1, then all of plane 2, and so on. That ordering is what makes truncation a literal byte PREFIX; a group-major interleave would store the same bits and have no prefix property at all, so the layout IS the claim.
stream: per plane per group of 64: 8 bytes of sign bits + one f16 scale = 1.25 bits/elem/plane
no_duplication_proof: total stream length equals the sum of the rung increments EXACTLY (55,705,600 == 4 x 13,926,400 on both tensors), and rung k is decoded from the first k increments of the SAME bytes. No level is stored twice, and there are no separate copies.
monotone: every rung is strictly more faithful than its prefix, on both tensors
the_real_value: A draft tier that costs NOTHING EXTRA. F1 established that multi-token or speculative execution is the only axis that moves the 100 TPS wall, and any such scheme needs a cheap draft. Here the draft is a BYTE PREFIX of the verify tier rather than a second artifact: rung 1 at 1.25 bits/elem and 0.620 ps/element (CODEC_ALU_COST) is free if the full ladder is already stored.
what_blocks_it: Realising that value requires the BODY to be the ladder, and G033 measured the ladder DOMINATED by flat codes above the coherence boundary in function space -- flat q3 at 3.25 b/elem beats rung 3 at 3.75 b/elem. So the Matryoshka STRUCTURE is demonstrated and the CODEC that would carry it is refuted. Those are separate findings and both stand.
gaps: EXACT ISLANDS, which the acceptance also names, are not implemented -- the stream is planes only
rungs are 4 planes at 1.25 b/elem each, not the H01/H03/H05/H09 widths the verify line names; the nesting property is what was demonstrated, at the widths the ladder produces
two tensors, two depths, MLP only
